decisions.rationale: Both named docs already exist on disk; validator confirms zero broken refs to either path; remaining textual mentions are intentional descriptions of the requirement itself. Recorded validator JSON as audit evidence in 57-01-SUMMARY.

Two prior anchor refs (#gsd-research-orchestrator) pointed nowhere because the AGENTS.md hadn't caught up to the v1.2 agent consolidation. Adding the section closes the doc-debt gap and resolves the broken anchors.

Codex HIGH review finding: naive **->.* substitution after escaping breaks **/*.md root-vs-nested matching. Algorithm lifts leading **/ and trailing /** to placeholders BEFORE regex-escape, then substitutes back to (?:.*/)? and .* patterns. Verified at unit and integration test levels.
Gemini LOW review finding: empty glob is a graceful no-op rather than throwing or matching everything. Avoids accidental whole-repo exclusion if a config has a stray empty value.

decisions.decision: Required YAML structural validation via python3+pyyaml (not Node+js-yaml)
decisions.rationale: Codex MEDIUM finding: grep-only YAML validation is too weak. js-yaml is not in node_modules and adding it would require a new dev dependency; python3+pyyaml is already available in the operator's environment, satisfying the same closure (structural correctness > grep-only).

decisions.decision: Dynamic owner/repo derivation via gh repo view --json owner,name
decisions.rationale: Codex MEDIUM finding: hard-coding repo slug invites drift on rename. Operator's command uses ${REPO_SLUG} shell variable; literal 'UsernameTron/Pete-Gets-Shit-Done' shown only as expected output for audit.

decisions.decision: Release-checklist gate keeps Phase 57 awaiting-operator-patch until PATCH verification
decisions.rationale: Codex MEDIUM/HIGH finding: operational gap between PR merge and PATCH application. Phase status stays gated until operator pastes 5-element JSON array into 57-03-SUMMARY '## Branch Protection Verification' section. STATE.md frontmatter explicitly tracks awaiting-operator-patch; ship status of v2.8 contingent on the same gate.

decisions.decision: Drift-detector single-leg gating to ubuntu/22 + full_suite=true
decisions.rationale: CONTEXT D-10: drift output is platform-independent; running on three matrix combos wastes CI minutes for zero signal gain. Step's if: predicate matches Generate coverage report and Upload coverage artifact predicates exactly.

decisions.decision: Wave 3 executed inline by orchestrator after agent stalls
decisions.rationale: Plans 57-01 and 57-02's first executor agent attempts stalled mid-task (one investigated phantom syntax errors; another investigated pre-existing test failures unrelated to scope). Orchestrator took over inline using the same plan structure, atomic commits, and acceptance criteria. No scope drift; deliverable matches plan exactly. Captured as a process observation for future agent skill-tuning.
